steps.en: Check and Pay page has Singpass and Corppass login buttons
steps.id: Halaman Check and Pay punya tombol login Singpass dan Corppass

steps.en: Browser is sent to the Singpass or Corppass login
steps.id: Browser diarahkan ke login Singpass atau Corppass
steps.why_en: The login screen itself is outside the code we can see.
steps.why_id: Layar login-nya sendiri ada di luar code yang bisa dilihat.

steps.en: System checks the login result and starts a session with the user's ID
steps.id: Sistem memeriksa hasil login dan memulai session dengan ID user

steps.en: Fines are searched automatically right after login
steps.id: Denda dicari otomatis begitu login selesai

steps.en: Search uses the logged-in person's ID, or the company ID for business
steps.id: Pencarian memakai ID orang yang login, atau ID perusahaan untuk business

steps.en: Page lists the user's outstanding fines with details
steps.id: Halaman menampilkan denda outstanding user beserta detailnya
